applyTo: "src/**/*.ts,src/**/*.tsx"

# ShelterPawtners Frontend Instructions

- Follow the existing ShelterPawtners design system and brand tokens.
- Build mobile-first and responsive.
- Maintain keyboard accessibility, visible focus, semantic labels, and useful error states.
- Do not communicate status by color alone.
- Use the centralized currency/accounting formatter for money.
- Do not scatter raw Supabase queries throughout presentational components.
- Reuse existing application/data-access abstractions.
- Never expose private Guardian, medical, financial, or organization data in public UI without an approved rule.
- Demo data must be visibly labeled where rendered.
- Avoid generic AI-style visual clutter, excessive glassmorphism, childish/cartoon pet visuals, and emoji navigation.
